title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1971-03-03
lineage: 1st generation reels (Revox A77) > Tascam DA-3000 > dBpoweramp 2496 > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Master Soundboard Reels > Pat Lee's 1st generation reels

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard of a one‑set Fillmore West benefit, though Pigpen’s organ is mixed overly loud.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the sole set the Dead played at their final Fillmore West appearance, offering clear soundboard audio but with an exaggerated organ level that doesn’t reflect the live balance. Fans appreciate the historic context despite the mix discrepancy.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4‑star) noting a solid performance and generally good soundboard quality, with a minor mix issue (organ too loud).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall soundboard capture; however Pigpen's organ is mixed much louder than it sounded live, making the recording feel different from the hall experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Single benefit set at Fillmore West; historically notable as the band's last performance there.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is mixed significantly louder than it was in the venue, affecting the perceived balance.
